OUTPUT
Touchscreens work by detecting user input through touch. There are two primary types of touchscreen technology: capacitive and resistive.

**Capacitive Touchscreens**
These screens detect touch by sensing changes in an electrostatic field. The surface of a capacitive touchscreen is coated with a transparent conductive material, typically Indium Tin Oxide (ITO), which creates a uniform electrostatic field across the screen [rocktech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGNYOwcmo_zGQ6YlQxnahYF9H9UO-OoDFGQf3ZYlvI32yJEiYw2CRCu1FNfR0z-2P7jcEr4osUnD9Ax3PdAxvriloPJlGLwZNCGB1GMc2f5XfFkWZYzpBQpCZngSQtY0gE3ilNnr2TxbBuw8Jm9LNNvlFJ0dgMXv9NWZZB1jVSJHJXrGgDpnJgdBA9ao3nStgsHLJi87UfDgZQ8Tx1qs3gGmQ8=) [hp](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEJ-9I-5hXBErMcfTyMWPfssgcL3GcnPLipWukqa7IPC4c_c8fJeVQJLE5WLeqXzi-8QFV0aHyy_7h3w8-uEDmJ4_K_91TLMI3muZXroQ86-xcXR3tr2yZ7bPdtW-15_esTKhyGUAXG1HSdDHlH1vVvdoRGB3vWc-mIGTWh-w==). When a conductive object, such as a finger, touches the screen, it draws a small electrical charge to that point, altering the electrostatic field [hp](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEJ-9I-5hXBErMcfTyMWPfssgcL3GcnPLipWukqa7IPC4c_c8fJeVQJLE5WLeqXzi-8QFV0aHyy_7h3w8-uEDmJ4_K_91TLMI3muZXroQ86-xcXR3tr2yZ7bPdtW-15_esTKhyGUAXG1HSdDHlH1vVvdoRGB3vWc-mIGTWh-w==) [mit](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGwoxLL-u2uHkQH3qYCB8ohgXcdFzzk4rkt2nWnVP_kahrD0znYyO8fUp6I3zq3aj6ndx6r_Td9c4dpqJR1rL6HNih3btvDEJGQb9KI4WkIhtf-Py0afYxKORe9OTcc2pXNy8S2BMEvcepbncnhHkmZ9vPQ9SLOFFNehtSekyqANMvF4xD1JQjrAhM=). This change in capacitance is detected by sensors, which are often arranged in a grid of electrodes [mit](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGwoxLL-u2uHkQH3qYCB8ohgXcdFzzk4rkt2nWnVP_kahrD0znYyO8fUp6I3zq3aj6ndx6r_Td9c4dpqJR1rL6HNih3btvDEJGQb9KI4WkIhtf-Py0afYxKORe9OTcc2pXNy8S2BMEvcepbncnhHkmZ9vPQ9SLOFFNehtSekyqANMvF4xD1JQjrAhM=) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHRfXrKvWnPWr3lUHWUEeg7_yWvrfhVU2cPiF1z2Lo1lZv5gYqgneEjOR_G95lgfvxTRx3Yw-ISspKI4VmlH6anKwBhW20k8GNHUqxZ-plMqZ-kF9xRjo9v92BDnGhAWcjwV8NP8FniQV0yHw-le7yN-WwQk3NLHYPpNL-MsJUj). These sensors convert the disruption in the electrostatic field into coordinates that the device's software interprets as a touch input [asu](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEqI50V8Ky6ASYnp76wg5bH9k8axq5dxSLNqtV9P1RYrhASGakAte9lWq7rLBT4i2sp3DsAAXNk13G-WsN5vEBCOyIzYM7vDFmfJG-FlPuBYyL-DtECZltG7QyceVZE29LMR7o-mus04ByvsVdTe_5Wjcud5OiP9J7MlOYo5PwuWLijPTu8lCgDqF4SxQS8_r4gWoZGFsVeMz9u). The speed at which these microcontrollers operate allows for smooth and responsive interactions [mit](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGwoxLL-u2uHkQH3qYCB8ohgXcdFzzk4rkt2nWnVP_kahrD0znYyO8fUp6I3zq3aj6ndx6r_Td9c4dpqJR1rL6HNih3btvDEJGQb9KI4WkIhtf-Py0afYxKORe9OTcc2pXNy8S2BMEvcepbncnhHkmZ9vPQ9SLOFFNehtSekyqANMvF4xD1JQjrAhM=).

There are two main types of capacitive touchscreens:
*   **Surface Capacitive:** This simpler type uses sensors at the corners and a thin film on the surface. It is often found in kiosks and ATMs and typically does not support multi-touch [butlertechnologies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFcKgS1c3GwB7W68L8tetNs_d9cT4vN1Xljf8JPs_IguYYWXte7d9sED_2SSqiaLJWOrzYwDZvk9iuR9DsCBQDGJmzdL-4c8hgNzzzuT3nEROYptk-nHdIJDMxqrNLRtjgcqS9OfklAMmeUs7gNJ5YXNoJPjXWz5Esatbb61Xa-bljlFFTb).
*   **Projected Capacitive (PCAP):** This is the more common and advanced type used in smartphones and tablets [scienceline](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGaoiityT8_lzq0R423kLybqgrAdrV5BYQXJbRuyuw7D--seoIEvhcRvXQXCRzSQDXQrWrfrsh14-hXb0ZUS_7nKWL2P-8KpDeHs1oo0a4I2BhnjALVbL8eKAhXvPMQo_AcLInl6oI_mqaergmFPKp6PrxEMGDcgNUDDEF0NbOhFMmsAWVPcIY=). PCAP screens have a grid of electrodes layered between glass sheets. When a finger touches the screen, it creates capacitance between the intersecting electrodes, allowing for precise touch detection and multi-touch capabilities like pinch-to-zoom [rocktech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGNYOwcmo_zGQ6YlQxnahYF9H9UO-OoDFGQf3ZYlvI32yJEiYw2CRCu1FNfR0z-2P7jcEr4osUnD9Ax3PdAxvriloPJlGLwZNCGB1GMc2f5XfFkWZYzpBQpCZngSQtY0gE3ilNnr2TxbBuw8Jm9LNNvlFJ0dgMXv9NWZZB1jVSJHJXrGgDpnJgdBA9ao3nStgsHLJi87UfDgZQ8Tx1qs3gGmQ8=) [uico](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFoyYzDzUHPEDgl2TnsYLcN3eLToJrKmPCTQ2iovj9AVGo2h41WAS9AyZxAuSuyIT5QWmnv3F7OEct6UbQimYSDdIQytw1MhvWVw_Q8Wl4r3RwWc0QI4lzg3P9VgJSAsuJjsihIM-q4rQ==). Modern devices predominantly use mutual capacitance, a subtype of PCAP, for enhanced multi-touch performance [rocktech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGNYOwcmo_zGQ6YlQxnahYF9H9UO-OoDFGQf3ZYlvI32yJEiYw2CRCu1FNfR0z-2P7jcEr4osUnD9Ax3PdAxvriloPJlGLwZNCGB1GMc2f5XfFkWZYzpBQpCZngSQtY0gE3ilNnr2TxbBuw8Jm9LNNvlFJ0dgMXv9NWZZB1jVSJHJXrGgDpnJgdBA9ao3nStgsHLJi87UfDgZQ8Tx1qs3gGmQ8=) [butlertechnologies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFcKgS1c3GwB7W68L8tetNs_d9cT4vN1Xljf8JPs_IguYYWXte7d9sED_2SSqiaLJWOrzYwDZvk9iuR9DsCBQDGJmzdL-4c8hgNzzzuT3nEROYptk-nHdIJDMxqrNLRtjgcqS9OfklAMmeUs7gNJ5YXNoJPjXWz5Esatbb61Xa-bljlFFTb).

Capacitive touchscreens are favored for their sensitivity, accuracy, durability, and multi-touch support [rocktech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGNYOwcmo_zGQ6YlQxnahYF9H9UO-OoDFGQf3ZYlvI32yJEiYw2CRCu1FNfR0z-2P7jcEr4osUnD9Ax3PdAxvriloPJlGLwZNCGB1GMc2f5XfFkWZYzpBQpCZngSQtY0gE3ilNnr2TxbBuw8Jm9LNNvlFJ0dgMXv9NWZZB1jVSJHJXrGgDpnJgdBA9ao3nStgsHLJi87UfDgZQ8Tx1qs3gGmQ8=) [butlertechnologies](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFcKgS1c3GwB7W68L8tetNs_d9cT4vN1Xljf8JPs_IguYYWXte7d9sED_2SSqiaLJWOrzYwDZvk9iuR9DsCBQDGJmzdL-4c8hgNzzzuT3nEROYptk-nHdIJDMxqrNLRtjgcqS9OfklAMmeUs7gNJ5YXNoJPjXWz5Esatbb61Xa-bljlFFTb). However, they generally require a conductive object to register a touch [scienceline](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGaoiityT8_lzq0R423kLybqgrAdrV5BYQXJbRuyuw7D--seoIEvhcRvXQXCRzSQDXQrWrfrsh14-hXb0ZUS_7nKWL2P-8KpDeHs1oo0a4I2BhnjALVbL8eKAhXvPMQo_AcLInl6oI_mqaergmFPKp6PrxEMGDcgNUDDEF0NbOhFMmsAWVPcIY=) [quora](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE0oDBQZzMwDoEymwn5N5mhOA54K4_N5MubFWhDYRHzyU5a0v0fDZof7PJYRidPhqT4GAiBbH5T1adMgHP1PqbOmyT17W5U2i_I-1DeNS1husZS0_jRN8S0EIKnZmupMPq9_IgpcPemcAGaLajmBBkVAE4_M_UhNlzSx00iCs8gAu_H827OAYDmYzXlSkho-bj6d1jQ5M33Q8SNlWZhymg8YQ8BLkIBRs9taBfOOuqYtvec-Kn1fqkJcur8vw==).

**Resistive Touchscreens**
These screens operate on a pressure-sensing principle, using two conductive layers separated by a small gap [goldenmargins](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHfVubeX4cFKWojgGAhUa3qCN-EbY4A-R6E4S6BHldWjtHCFz3RgShK8IjK6caGu4BdtIuTWqHEmsVftEJhOmoQbrfIc4AQ9ZRoKc2A9c5tDVPXGC0DlluscRUy45Dbr9DDvsq8j8ChsVdxJoU7BwRlLc900lWNoirNOkO0). When pressure is applied to the screen, these layers make contact, completing an electrical circuit and registering the touch input [leehonlcd](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFRerabNMonStmTkRa8G4H2WyRBuR_PtmMJ4KI6Fk8mkE-itHF6Gc66TBEhCs3SKEiKF0Un7yBvyRNqTVDGXmNbTa-6o4ztkQSE-hqI28DP5mgLEEg3Ks9InIKeeCW3BV_HLj5O93UZKxXr1qg_E8_L9qDaLQSHJlz6JU4fglT2xUQ7QFNPdFqCgl55W4Yb-0JxzB0Y7M8wK4TLyfMX). The structure typically consists of a flexible top layer and a rigid bottom layer, both coated with a transparent conductive material like ITO [goldenmargins](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHfVubeX4cFKWojgGAhUa3qCN-EbY4A-R6E4S6BHldWjtHCFz3RgShK8IjK6caGu4BdtIuTWqHEmsVftEJhOmoQbrfIc4AQ9ZRoKc2A9c5tDVPXGC0DlluscRUy45Dbr9DDvsq8j8ChsVdxJoU7BwRlLc900lWNoirNOkO0) [admetro](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZscdClumCGWHMXz1IUVU4XDvgwEVNqAt39FyoFuqSdKnApvt1FL0wVXetxfmtHv_uPZzmEYGRGzE6R6cyxKG_GDWm6YF07PNWXEsiLLqKQYZr7LsiNaG26FuPeOscWVd6V54s58hRjntAtv5hnTvm6kRwVR8Emho2N1lPWmeQXvARR50If5j9C_Stg3N7_s2fbKwvR_KVbPRcIr0cxOm05g==). Spacer dots or an adhesive layer keep these layers apart when not in use [goldenmargins](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHfVubeX4cFKWojgGAhUa3qCN-EbY4A-R6E4S6BHldWjtHCFz3RgShK8IjK6caGu4BdtIuTWqHEmsVftEJhOmoQbrfIc4AQ9ZRoKc2A9c5tDVPXGC0DlluscRUy45Dbr9DDvsq8j8ChsVdxJoU7BwRlLc900lWNoirNOkO0).

When the top layer is pressed, it contacts the bottom layer. A voltage is applied across one layer, creating a voltage gradient. The controller measures the change in electrical resistance or voltage at the point of contact to calculate the X and Y coordinates [goldenmargins](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHfVubeX4cFKWojgGAhUa3qCN-EbY4A-R6E4S6BHldWjtHCFz3RgShK8IjK6caGu4BdtIuTWqHEmsVftEJhOmoQbrfIc4AQ9ZRoKc2A9c5tDVPXGC0DlluscRUy45Dbr9DDvsq8j8ChsVdxJoU7BwRlLc900lWNoirNOkO0) [admetro](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHZscdClumCGWHMXz1IUVU4XDvgwEVNqAt39FyoFuqSdKnApvt1FL0wVXetxfmtHv_uPZzmEYGRGzE6R6cyxKG_GDWm6YF07PNWXEsiLLqKQYZr7LsiNaG26FuPeOscWVd6V54s58hRjntAtv5hnTvm6kRwVR8Emho2N1lPWmeQXvARR50If5j9C_Stg3N7_s2fbKwvR_KVbPRcIr0cxOm05g==). Different configurations, such as four-wire, five-wire, and eight-wire systems, exist, offering varying levels of accuracy and features [leehonlcd](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFRerabNMonStmTkRa8G4H2WyRBuR_PtmMJ4KI6Fk8mkE-itHF6Gc66TBEhCs3SKEiKF0Un7yBvyRNqTVDGXmNbTa-6o4ztkQSE-hqI28DP5mgLEEg3Ks9InIKeeCW3BV_HLj5O93UZKxXr1qg_E8_L9qDaLQSHJlz6JU4fglT2xUQ7QFNPdFqCgl55W4Yb-0JxzB0Y7M8wK4TLyfMX) [dush](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHLWG4HLptlfjqtLyJA_syHXDihaCxsjhfJo330pu9FNV2INlPNvzT2XRhmh-JEof8uTQAj813rFTJlzDmlQhkyBvTDgGWh2QCSnTWQDXf_kyzFVCNCmoP3kw4bv4

Gene therapy is a medical technology that aims to treat or prevent diseases by modifying gene expression or altering the biological properties of living cells [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHBxbGnLpIx6PAb5_Bcdqs57pWqBnDgIvsR5FpQ4_Yh4DV4z7YP1wotDT6iB2p6l6PZ1loFQDnNEeWCvQN-pfZvVSy7Lgi7L65ujrmacZrrF8BgNda7qZO_elTz0Q4yc4npKRnN). This innovative approach addresses the root cause of diseases at the genetic level [forbes](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHMZq3MXoibQvt_E7edXuMiLosqZMK5gcI5IIvbMZgGP4BFw8stHF1w3Mr_coWm5Cp-VcB_8DzGQy0_1n4ODe1EapRB40pFxvDQOELk-ntJxef7YrKWeFlR3_3dAsHOw-5TtQY9LgoP3wmd9hqRXgSf-INmUS2YQwGUBUb2M2d6lgE7ap-TC5zq4e0qj99KsflztejpI-kiJNfbTMdWPUPykqLjWXs_A11Ouyk0nzeI2aaOu8iHfKlR6xAPXRzKoF-06BlaYrapoVjn). As of January 2026, gene therapy is rapidly becoming a life-changing reality, offering new hope for patients with serious conditions like cancer, inherited genetic disorders, and blood diseases [continentalhospitals](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFbLSglpR4UVPKph7LcyscNQPq_5tCl8J8tMIJgbXCzTNGSZGCDw-8JXcgjLI4KRmcSb6lLqfVTpTJJ6A4a-Y1pVGL6K1cgwQ6JwaTn7ERjg2gQ7jJYoy9lnCJNe31rrfMQ7im1rYPLw64_MEdt1JO008ngpyakzCy3AoA8auseMQzM_A==).

The mechanisms by which gene therapy works include:
*   **Gene Addition:** Introducing a healthy copy of a gene to cells when a faulty gene is unable to produce a necessary protein [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHk4QY_N89yOO968mzFdCf5Y9miWk4GOgbOWVehN-wzxFY7BmlIsnCczDmj_Ywnode0NIpAM-9yZReZrmk91tXM3OZHzU7i6Z-s9JPX327B6wqerD8GiiNAfJekWrZh1WeHbPHGzDNg_n9570E3KHEmObfem-yLqXhfdtn2pA==).
*   **Gene Editing:** Using tools like CRISPR-Cas9 to make precise changes to a cell's DNA, correcting mutations or modifying biological processes [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHk4QY_N89yOO968mzFdCf5Y9miWk4GOgbOWVehN-wzxFY7BmlIsnCczDmj_Ywnode0NIpAM-9yZReZrmk91tXM3OZHzU7i6Z-s9JPX327B6wqerD8GiiNAfJekWrZh1WeHbPHGzDNg_n9570E3KHEmObfem-yLqXhfdtn2pA==) [cmsatoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8X5x660NZGdQaweu9nsRJQi1yzuFD0HM_P7oAZvWOxbn4SQvXl71gErm5_HJ7h49U6mDqWo1KDgUax1U9QRf75dCkVuNbYt-mm3XSKhm7CSmbodrxXoZNJMaHLMInBKnzS7fvm_CfpJfagiUfrOPlXp78jgX79GxZknzNNklVGuSWpBl3-gIFvSfRHZU7B8zuWI7-Yk7cCMAHEZ2VBtEYt6Jt8dlnqAI=). For example, CRISPR-Cas9 has been used to reactivate dormant hemoglobin genes in individuals with sickle cell disease [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGHejG9tmNeWEQfu3twgYDe4XjyGlor7XB-e5FWVuE20ait_pJ6bGVVhPj6jCKITVfVd7SXSbK2XjSKFAkJ39ugrowfNW7w4erwoeESGJ85hoEud_LwW0UZ2laf3_LfhqSaftnLDAZjRPomLjA=).
*   **Gene Silencing:** Reducing or stopping the expression of harmful genes, often through methods like RNA interference (RNAi) [clevelandclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHk4QY_N89yOO968mzFdCf5Y9miWk4GOgbOWVehN-wzxFY7BmlIsnCczDmj_Ywnode0NIpAM-9yZReZrmk91tXM3OZHzU7i6Z-s9JPX327B6wqerD8GiiNAfJekWrZh1WeHbPHGzDNg_n9570E3KHEmObfem-yLqXhfdtn2pA==) [cmsatoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8X5x660NZGdQaweu9nsRJQi1yzuFD0HM_P7oAZvWOxbn4SQvXl71gErm5_HJ7h49U6mDqWo1KDgUax1U9QRf75dCkVuNbYt-mm3XSKhm7CSmbodrxXoZNJMaHLMInBKnzS7fvm_CfpJfagiUfrOPlXp78jgX79GxZknzNNklVGuSWpBl3-gIFvSfRHZU7B8zuWI7-Yk7cCMAHEZ2VBtEYt6Jt8dlnqAI=).

Therapeutic genes are delivered using vectors, which can be viral or non-viral [forbes](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHMZq3MXoibQvt_E7edXuMiLosqZMK5gcI5IIvbMZgGP4BFw8stHF1w3Mr_coWm5Cp-VcB_8DzGQy0_1n4ODe1EapRB40pFxvDQOELk-ntJxef7YrKWeFlR3_3dAsHOw-5TtQY9LgoP3wmd9hqRXgSf-INmUS2YQwGUBUb2M2d6lgE7ap-TC5zq4e0qj99KsflztejpI-kiJNfbTMdWPUPykqLjWXs_A11Ouyk0nzeI2aaOu8iHfKlR6xAPXRzKoF-06BlaYrapoVjn) [fda](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEsBma6wl9LMUKiEuorK0ktZir6OwALw8U4tnQehs41r4k5oHC3oce6Y-3fWf43ZH-lGBcM3g-S8JaqMneCDG8wwOYCZZwjvdwkKjDPHNMLgP60xLiVBNwBpHlnxjs7F0ttHWt489JJc1rTcLGhJyYZ0z5c_rT9hALxAgiGPwCZ6gta0KQQ6iJdNpyd_mcNrqDjGQSXAQY_). Viral vectors, such as adeno-associated viruses (AAVs) and lentiviruses, are common due to their efficiency in delivering genetic material [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHBxbGnLpIx6PAb5_Bcdqs57pWqBnDgIvsR5FpQ4_Yh4DV4z7YP1wotDT6iB2p6l6PZ1loFQDnNEeWCvQN-pfZvVSy7Lgi7L65ujrmacZrrF8BgNda7qZO_elTz0Q4yc4npKRnN) [fda](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEsBma6wl9LMUKiEuorK0ktZir6OwALw8U4tnQehs41r4k5oHC3oce6Y-3fWf43ZH-lGBcM3g-S8JaqMneCDG8wwOYCZZwjvdwkKjDPHNMLgP60xLiVBNwBpHlnxjs7F0ttHWt489JJc1rTcLGhJyYZ0z5c_rT9hALxAgiGPwCZ6gta0KQQ6iJdNpyd_mcNrqDjGQSXAQY_). Non-viral methods, including plasmid DNA, bacterial vectors, and lipid nanoparticles, are also being explored [fda](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEsBma6wl9LMUKiEuorK0ktZir6OwALw8U4tnQehs41r4k5oHC3oce6Y-3fWf43ZH-lGBcM3g-S8JaqMneCDG8wwOYCZZwjvdwkKjDPHNMLgP60xLiVBNwBpHlnxjs7F0ttHWt489JJc1rTcLGhJyYZ0z5c_rT9hALxAgiGPwCZ6gta0KQQ6iJdNpyd_mcNrqDjGQSXAQY_) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGHejG9tmNeWEQfu3twgYDe4XjyGlor7XB-e5FWVuE20ait_pJ6bGVVhPj6jCKITVfVd7SXSbK2XjSKFAkJ39ugrowfNW7w4erwoeESGJ85hoEud_LwW0UZ2laf3_LfhqSaftnLDAZjRPomLjA=). Gene therapy can be administered in two main ways:
*   **In Vivo Transduction:** Delivering genetic material directly into the body to target specific tissues [cmsatoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8X5x660NZGdQaweu9nsRJQi1yzuFD0HM_P7oAZvWOxbn4SQvXl71gErm5_HJ7h49U6mDqWo1KDgUax1U9QRf75dCkVuNbYt-mm3XSKhm7CSmbodrxXoZNJMaHLMInBKnzS7fvm_CfpJfagiUfrOPlXp78jgX79GxZknzNNklVGuSWpBl3-gIFvSfRHZU7B8zuWI7-Yk7cCMAHEZ2VBtEYt6Jt8dlnqAI=).
*   **Ex Vivo Transduction:** Modifying cells outside the body before reintroducing them to the patient [cmsatoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8X5x660NZGdQaweu9nsRJQi1yzuFD0HM_P7oAZvWOxbn4SQvXl71gErm5_HJ7h49U6mDqWo1KDgUax1U9QRf75dCkVuNbYt-mm3XSKhm7CSmbodrxXoZNJMaHLMInBKnzS7fvm_CfpJfagiUfrOPlXp78jgX79GxZknzNNklVGuSWpBl3-gIFvSfRHZU7B8zuWI7-Yk7cCMAHEZ2VBtEYt6Jt8dlnqAI=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHBxbGnLpIx6PAb5_Bcdqs57pWqBnDgIvsR5FpQ4_Yh4DV4z7YP1wotDT6iB2p6l6PZ1loFQDnNEeWCvQN-pfZvVSy7Lgi7L65ujrmacZrrF8BgNda7qZO_elTz0Q4yc4npKRnN). CAR T-cell therapy, used for certain blood cancers, is an example where a patient's immune cells are engineered to target tumors [continentalhospitals](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFbLSglpR4UVPKph7LcyscNQPq_5tCl8J8tMIJgbXCzTNGSZGCDw-8JXcgjLI4KRmcSb6lLqfVTpTJJ6A4a-Y1pVGL6K1cgwQ6JwaTn7ERjg2gQ7jJYoy9lnCJNe31rrfMQ7im1rYPLw64_MEdt1JO008ngpyakzCy3AoA8auseMQzM_A==) [cmsatoday](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE8X5x660NZGdQaweu9nsRJQi1yzuFD0HM_P7oAZvWOxbn4SQvXl71gErm5_HJ7h49U6mDqWo1KDgUax1U9QRf75dCkVuNbYt-mm3XSKhm7CSmbodrxXoZNJMaHLMInBKnzS7fvm_CfpJfagiUfrOPlXp78jgX79GxZknzNNklVGuSWpBl3-gIFvSfRHZU7B8zuWI7-Yk7cCMAHEZ2VBtEYt6Jt8dlnqAI=).

Recent advancements in 2025 have led to significant breakthroughs in gene therapy for various conditions, including genetic blindness, hemophilia, and muscular dystrophy [continentalhospitals](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFbLSglpR4UVPKph7LcyscNQPq_5tCl8J8tMIJgbXCzTNGSZGCDw-8JXcgjLI4KRmcSb6lLqfVTpTJJ6A4a-Y1pVGL6K1cgwQ6JwaTn7ERjg2gQ7jJYoy9lnCJNe31rrfMQ7im1rYPLw64_MEdt1JO008ngpyakzCy3AoA8auseMQzM_A==). This allows for much faster processing than retrieving information from long-term storage like hard drives or SSDs [apnews](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/id/1-0) [itamg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX) [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEtWi34WTd_WX4GkjDnLAiT4BSLMo-sFND2ZDpuVT7ccpNEun3m38YFmO-bnYQf3qX9ItL7b8MMNu343kaXIW6hdkb2vCl_h0tZmWuNvLIGyPzNa0vX0gSZ-TylQedyvrr6VCPDfli4PLCF9rWKTpVxSgSQ78B_S7XnDVqJ4o3DrV_350t97FCjzx1ooZp30_tNxIyV0QvbaDEP_wga8oEA0QCu46Y=). ### How RAM Works: Architecture and Data Access

RAM is structured as an array of memory cells, each storing a single bit (0 or 1) [rose-hulman](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFf78qNLaqzpab6hCD2JoEU73047SNwZtAQ6CUw78QFBOBQHHItrYj04nAct5VTn9h5-Dz8wgrByNvFFzALAJFIgrha5Yjbmc_MYQh28LgShAmrXW2AsrkC9ZKA5-Rkc6rkqqBuyivhiOT1J-vSIbjO6iDYPKSQuFmW2lJSZUTc5Rb2NjdvhrMf74Q=) [channelinsider](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGklaDmrfftngTRgxb-VYDz-yp22k5SgyPlNButpF12cq-vrKkuWwrlJ9A1_9vo5I374Pix2m09cOOXmHVWyTCuuWV_B2XkYUJMQfW7XKGhj6gmwgD5hhAlHhLP2UG-VaxRGN68dHLI4cf58BozDXv210KfGeXo6jHAhEfK2Up1x5EUlztaZXk0VwnQbH7f) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGCmpICIy-cEAMWyl_2uX0tviQAzdfV-Wv3_DA3kROy-MkOpVDtxtMv-zm0wN8P3zMNDnKyjhE48c60OLvMPDRUVQs7O130usMWO2XDfMf5eGFA3McCTKPzct30qGApF73Z8luyvYq4krnZTPet_M_hSQTA5H5LMsnnuKwFn-XvjXzuaaLiCqY=). These cells are organized in rows and columns, with each cell having a unique address determined by its row and column intersection [howstuffworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEXBGphVIlWyqXscXzw5PlzM70ml5DvV2OVNlUFH_sbOvZYNPwCPbcNknnoW0I4PxiW9R3eV6EsMvjIebtPlJg1KVdvMCzvAc_dHNF1P7jk67i8LwYnpPba-SpIW97pmWQXxkyNlg==) [rose-hulman](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFf78qNLaqzpab6hCD2JoEU73047SNwZtAQ6CUw78QFBOBQHHItrYj04nAct5VTn9h5-Dz8wgrByNvFFzALAJFIgrha5Yjbmc_MYQh28LgShAmrXW2AsrkC9ZKA5-Rkc6rkqqBuyivhiOT1J-vSIbjO6iDYPKSQuFmW2lJSZUTc5Rb2NjdvhrMf74Q=) [channelinsider](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGklaDmrfftngTRgxb-VYDz-yp22k5SgyPlNButpF12cq-vrKkuWwrlJ9A1_9vo5I374Pix2m09cOOXmHVWyTCuuWV_B2XkYUJMQfW7XKGhj6gmwgD5hhAlHhLP2UG-VaxRGN68dHLI4cf58BozDXv210KfGeXo6jHAhEfK2Up1x5EUlztaZXk0VwnQbH7f). The RAM controller accesses specific memory locations by sending the row and column addresses through electrical pathways on the chip [rose-hulman](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFf78qNLaqzpab6hCD2JoEU73047SNwZtAQ6CUw78QFBOBQHHItrYj04nAct5VTn9h5-Dz8wgrByNvFFzALAJFIgrha5Yjbmc_MYQh28LgShAmrXW2AsrkC9ZKA5-Rkc6rkqqBuyivhiOT1J-vSIbjO6iDYPKSQuFmW2lJSZUTc5Rb2NjdvhrMf74Q=) [channelinsider](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGklaDmrfftngTRgxb-VYDz-yp22k5SgyPlNButpF12cq-vrKkuWwrlJ9A1_9vo5I374Pix2m09cOOXmHVWyTCuuWV_B2XkYUJMQfW7XKGhj6gmwgD5hhAlHhLP2UG-VaxRGN68dHLI4cf58BozDXv210KfGeXo6jHAhEfK2Up1x5EUlztaZXk0VwnQbH7f) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGCmpICIy-cEAMWyl_2uX0tviQAzdfV-Wv3_DA3kROy-MkOpVDtxtMv-zm0wN8P3zMNDnKyjhE48c60OLvMPDRUVQs7O130usMWO2XDfMf5eGFA3McCTKPzct30qGApF73Z8luyvYq4krnZTPet_M_hSQTA5H5LMsnnuKwFn-XvjXzuaaLiCqY=). Data is read from or written to these locations via separate data lines [rose-hulman](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFf78qNLaqzpab6hCD2JoEU73047SNwZtAQ6CUw78QFBOBQHHItrYj04nAct5VTn9h5-Dz8wgrByNvFFzALAJFIgrha5Yjbmc_MYQh28LgShAmrXW2AsrkC9ZKA5-Rkc6rkqqBuyivhiOT1J-vSIbjO6iDYPKSQuFmW2lJSZUTc5Rb2NjdvhrMf74Q=) [techtarget](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGCmpICIy-cEAMWyl_2uX0tviQAzdfV-Wv3_DA3kROy-MkOpVDtxtMv-zm0wN8P3zMNDnKyjhE48c60OLvMPDRUVQs7O130usMWO2XDfMf5eGFA3McCTKPzct30qGApF73Z8luyvYq4krnZTPet_M_hSQTA5H5LMsnnuKwFn-XvjXzuaaLiCqY=). Modern RAM chips can store multiple bits at a single coordinate, corresponding to the data bus width, enabling simultaneous access to multiple bits [channelinsider](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGklaDmrfftngTRgxb-VYDz-yp22k5SgyPlNButpF12cq-vrKkuWwrlJ9A1_9vo5I374Pix2m09cOOXmHVWyTCuuWV_B2XkYUJMQfW7XKGhj6gmwgD5hhAlHhLP2UG-VaxRGN68dHLI4cf58BozDXv210KfGeXo6jHAhEfK2Up1x5EUlztaZXk0VwnQbH7f).

When a program is launched or data is accessed, it is transferred from slower, long-term storage (like an SSD or HDD) into RAM [avast](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHq2eeL8VIY8wH2IzMjoeB0ztQC679mtmVuGGlatomAYkBp70FuB3lOtJAJHt68j1aZa0lCVoAGert8iSRk4FmfHjTOG5wliYYHnVE19WRY44OaioMJ3FRxexaLgCaznm_wVN9MfQ==) [medium](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX1). The CPU then fetches this information from RAM to perform calculations [quora](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX6) [affanhost](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX7). RAM itself doesn't process data; it solely provides rapid access to the data and instructions needed by the CPU [quora](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX6). The speed of reading from and writing to RAM is critical for overall system performance [itamg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX). More RAM allows a computer to handle larger amounts of data and run more applications concurrently, enhancing multitasking [teachcomputerscience](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX8) [itamg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYbmUS_nk3axbOIKqCP-8Dxrwv7CTd3CDkSEXZT07Qxcur7jmYPeTZvyv5656La-oLR7Wls9WoMmQ3RW6aFFRLl6jrdJN0dIA6Pyw-azoUlfIJPjOfbPfrpqNNrOIUNTnsYnzG9SNX).

*   Collisions of neutron stars [caltech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHllxEWR3rOw7xMChoOMuromxqG_XftEGzhVDAqWL_pQ_6sr7ongaVjquoZF133OseolKRiVBglubMPkha-Uacx4F6AKAempc0vjWQexeGQkeAG1FTX-Wa1aaFfgV2nmFWeNyYXcMoNsw==) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYq35lXcawm12egI7T_d5duk3pPNaCSmuWQNOeCdqqw1K1XL7IoMIy8leYsaPt6R_GJwYQNo24RRW2cxZ8MseL9ILLOGV1KxLJZ0nMkoAJ6EnVp1KF9z_t0FsIAG8iz02ppPGTMSHrL4FkeA==)

    "question": "What is the Higgs boson?",
    "initial_queries": 1,

OUTPUT
The Higgs boson is a fundamental particle in the Standard Model of particle physics, resulting from the quantum excitation of the Higgs field. This field is pervasive throughout the universe and is responsible for imparting mass to other fundamental particles [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGEpaaHX9BiKcI6FP0nMa2PzoaDeuSlnghDPU0h3G8Ecdfrfjkgsh8a8Y7-WZqpmM5SV2bA3f8drZbRu1TBsxWGpZ8P9hCluLzH6Aq6HPT9KtSjcLbusi0ZoJ3UAn_Q30DdvT0=). Without the Higgs field and the associated Brout-Englert-Higgs mechanism, particles would be massless and travel at the speed of light [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEZKuCJcUTajcx1AZieRAeY38E1S_-fGCnaQXH6Czgz59xeLLiZoytSNiANA2x6eTS75tdwo6zQNGe4MUfsM1K89qwQJEi5U7qNJTURo8RxeH5fJ07tK1PqTTS5XJ-47qoyRPQv5sTVVvHHTsPlMEF1fJU=).

The Higgs boson itself has a mass of approximately 125 GeV/c², making it about 130 times more massive than a proton [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGEpaaHX9BiKcI6FP0nMa2PzoaDeuSlnghDPU0h3G8Ecdfrfjkgsh8a8Y7-WZqpmM5SV2bA3f8drZbRu1TBsxWGpZ8P9hCluLzH6Aq6HPT9KtSjcLbusi0ZoJ3UAn_Q30DdvT0=). It is a scalar boson with zero spin and even parity, meaning it has no intrinsic angular momentum and its parity is positive [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGVsoe8sf6EiLXe7qVOctNsphv0NIiFTsOTRMNuJGDPclrd4qFU27ILVs_DsfDNtNZ7ztt81cOCxc9IGAlSzJN1OzL0Sip4-66weI428YvtaesRWAmKG5d6SJZiOpOpYVVM-tcb). The Higgs boson carries no electric charge and no color charge [home](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF0277n-UbzN6Afk5gWB9tJ7L6_A3v8BezX3w1W8vdZFiEgoZS_f_zaWu6ds2E7TXNz2dtdvWT85gmK5XfF4PGikyKSBH6ESM82KM9RJJ7Ao7NX-mgsaRxdWF829Wt3dJByoDBtrIY95ZnWWJU4HKZSjCc=). It is highly unstable and decays into other particles almost immediately after its creation [glassalmanac](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFcq5xTomDcMv1vHDj57Agh4yDTvro--Iv3P9nRPnkXZqw5VMMoGDlHkY_bnlHleOqJxTv1QXIoln-ZfvtQTQ0t7Hc05cKvDpnG5O3fpSEgZ4Mgn18JQBn27ET0hndbGb6PJiet1ud3s24ixHnRLXpOpyRmFsrHQmbGl0qfcvD0sWPpKZ1GuwM=2).

The Higgs boson's significance lies in its interaction with mass. Particles acquire mass through their interactions with the Higgs field; the stronger the interaction, the greater the mass of the particle [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGVsoe8sf6EiLXe7qVOctNsphv0NIiFTsOTRMNuJGDPclrd4qFU27ILVs_DsfDNtNZ7ztt81cOCxc9IGAlSzJN1OzL0Sip4-66weI428YvtaesRWAmKG5d6SJZiOpOpYVVM-tcb). This mechanism is crucial for the W and Z bosons, which mediate the weak force, to acquire their substantial mass, thus explaining the short range of this fundamental force [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHybBKezL40ECW93O7dclLpMEoXqpNimqjrW4J_MfX8r4OcE0XfWw__Fr89YZ8oJT4kX1xi8rYRAaTtruAn7rCF2L8-xDP_onvGe-azFSccv8nduJE_8bqJWt0jQUsuU83vsxKuz-HJ).

The theoretical basis for the Higgs boson was laid out in 1964 by Peter Higgs, along with Robert Brout and François Englert, who independently proposed the Higgs mechanism [cern](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE2Zc4JXOS7hQ54KVmLOGmADDGHKsW_Nykn9sHDKQqm6fcuF_qTsoM0etdejB2i5QZzLo_cj_hAc5-Twry3_fEbQeXDTHl19orIpabYu3o5papoNX_09fcsVZbX8YLuXYKlA0OfPnUVwrsI). The experimental discovery of the Higgs boson occurred on July 4, 2012, by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at CERN's Large Hadron Collider (LHC) [atlas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHC_gHmztPsQ1HPkU5o_IdIHsrQscRwvFzZET263-xuHwrGZ9dW1mjR0wgq_xRYF_VJLku0suWzXYJJQ4mnCMQlUrVd7uppIQgiVc5JxsBn_VDJa_6ERQ8NgpBTAIp0ziv-WhOl). This landmark discovery confirmed the Standard Model of particle physics and led to the Nobel Prize in Physics for François Englert and Peter Higgs in 2013 [atlas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFcq5xTomDcMv1vHDj57Agh4yDTvro--Iv3P9nRPnkXZqw5VMMoGDlHkY_bnlHleOqJxTv1QXIoln-ZfvtQTQ0t7Hc05cKvDpnG5O3fpSEgZ4Mgn18JQBn27ET0hndbGb6PJiet1ud3s24ixHnRLXpOpyRmFsrHQmbGl0qfcvD0sWPpKZ1GuwM=3) [atlas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHC_gHmztPsQ1HPkU5o_IdIHsrQscRwvFzZET263-xuHwrGZ9dW1mjR0wgq_xRYF_VJLku0suWzXYJJQ4mnCMQlUrVd7uppIQgiVc5JxsBn_VDJa_6ERQ8NgpBTAIp0ziv-WhOl).

Research at the LHC, particularly by the ATLAS and CMS collaborations, continues to precisely measure the Higgs boson's properties, including its decays into various particles like photons, W and Z bosons, tau leptons, bottom quarks, and muons [atlas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGkTCJKHiigmZ52y3-v6XkOIqE1qdIqJNNmH3Rp08eS-_WteW4JyLoD3ZmuGWZB9YhEa57Ydo5leiI0aoLfRhn2NwuZdLxHNGHOY3nEOmYB1rKgLa2dZun5-vOlRhv-Z8EyW8Nch9D73piBLGLYWOf6-vyuM_fFDKndnt_ih_J5FwyUPYwxRKSndpkDeBlWLBgPwHjhqb2WlHx7nzMA9TE1) [cms](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFICAHn84-M9BcY_OfIBpBdyi3v_j9cIWXXdT1N1omp4s5aYjjS2RvtfS_KLFqUzz-t9LeVOMBsEn47xHAjpv4TUSVYkZpnfji5_vbQDt5PQl7PBt1qC7Ht7nT4FubBlHV8d_Dazqulf__mPo_IEEO6fs7VzMt1V0A=). These ongoing studies aim to verify its consistency with the Standard Model and search for any deviations that might indicate new physics beyond our current understanding [energy](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF3acsR75m4wdgstRwnbMTlZnkXJxsCjw4pCbacp-LH9t-BnxEIlL1ZR6olHtPE-vPrfmtD6ULpguajDFTTsrOMq2iJ1xWQRU6SsuHYbDRvEAwgOApKL2tQi6s7oMRh5wzn21K3Wcl_bMsMfVb-R5Rv3ZJFfA==) [atlas](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEy4hYIipkDQGPPbXcRuYmg-3DADJq3WH38kxhNWJdENvJ6QYZN3fxZq0uH9IKWwHqfv9Z3exZ-I3BmsUbYFbQD0y3brxJa_Y0f0Ih_-6-qE6KwFlTrmzvdaFv0NMK0qz90uPElv0k=8). The Higgs boson's properties also offer potential insights into mysteries such as dark matter [space](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEZKuCJcUTajcx1AZieRAeY38E1S_-fGCnaQXH6Czgz59xeLLiZoytSNiANA2x6eTS75tdwo6zQNGe4MUfsM1K89qwQJEi5U7qNJTURo8RxeH5fJ07tK1PqTTS5XJ-47qoyRPQv5sTVVvHHTsPlMEF1fJU=).

Batteries generate electricity through electrochemical reactions, converting stored chemical energy into electrical energy. This process relies on the transfer of electrons between substances, known as oxidation-reduction (redox) reactions [semcoinfratech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAxaJmW66OEb93RZ0cqa_jsA4Em4QDt9OBS7kw9oAF59zIW00mnUWKzWaAjI4_8fapawGS6dLf9q0LzUXfk_sda63mgsplnRUpr8L04MV6RYSh1jmwvbmeVdz0zUEeokvuGcXxqZjw4xpcc2qRD_k0qlN-D4l6eQbAHnuLMmtoZPbF8gBlXTQ4) [researchgate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGktGbRP_JMpGz5ilTn7CSd3dczihBIl-fj1UW0AF44U9m5856n358qg2bKBkZeRFuVGGKyFEq2ORrhgMb6C0pIIWJtDX5_5U3FZ6_7MBrhRLUHgk4RM7K-3w43uUUrPz2-XuwTLW6Sqw-U3AP6a9dbie83PaSwCrAMHwFPIKh2avxwSh3YxtI66ZTCwV8REIjsw1hImjGKUCRVKN05_cIeEyTdIzT1o_V1OB0XtXwxmo2-IQPp).

A battery typically consists of four main components:
*   **Anode (Negative Electrode):** This is where oxidation occurs, releasing electrons during the battery's discharge cycle [semcoinfratech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAxaJmW66OEb93RZ0cqa_jsA4Em4QDt9OBS7kw9oAF59zIW00mnUWKzWaAjI4_8fapawGS6dLf9q0LzUXfk_sda63mgsplnRUpr8L04MV6RYSh1jmwvbmeVdz0zUEeokvuGcXxqZjw4xpcc2qRD_k0qlN-D4l6eQbAHnuLMmtoZPbF8gBlXTQ4).
*   **Cathode (Positive Electrode):** This is where reduction takes place, accepting electrons during discharge [semcoinfratech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAxaJmW66OEb93RZ0cqa_jsA4Em4QDt9OBS7kw9oAF59zIW00mnUWKzWaAjI4_8fapawGS6dLf9q0LzUXfk_sda63mgsplnRUpr8L04MV6RYSh1jmwvbmeVdz0zUEeokvuGcXxqZjw4xpcc2qRD_k0qlN-D4l6eQbAHnuLMmtoZPbF8gBlXTQ4).
*   **Electrolyte:** This medium allows ions to move between the anode and cathode, completing the internal circuit [redway-tech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4JGKiTUFkTff-mh8UBXRIB19Y5hL6Ws7iaFt0hWmqZmYhNe4kNju_6m1NzrCNmpiLtcsUTM6O4OC6EeKSI8PqfhmrT7a9txdE_0f-ELIenK-2RslhvuJHFglOOh7cNLIr13olcUDEFd2MVeQH2biWiwbWZEubPRIDCdA=) [semcoinfratech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAxaJmW66OEb93RZ0cqa_jsA4Em4QDt9OBS7kw9oAF59zIW00mnUWKzWaAjI4_8fapawGS6dLf9q0LzUXfk_sda63mgsplnRUpr8L04MV6RYSh1jmwvbmeVdz0zUEeokvuGcXxqZjw4xpcc2qRD_k0qlN-D4l6eQbAHnuLMmtoZPbF8gBlXTQ4). Electrolytes can be in liquid, gel, or solid-state form [semcoinfratech](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAxaJmW66OEb93RZ0cqa_jsA4Em4QDt9OBS7kw9oAF59zIW00mnUWKzWaAjI4_8fapawGS6dLf9q0LzUXfk_sda63mgsplnRUpr8L04MV6RYSh1jmwvbmeVdz0zUEeokvuGcXxqZjw4xpcc2qRD_k0qlN-D4l6eQbAHnuLMmtoZPbF8gBlXTQ4).

Submarines operate using the principle of buoyancy, which is the upward force exerted by water that counteracts the submarine's weight [globecomposite](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHVTgnsKX3tas56PDNgc4Ymsx05x6c3UvW72FphlNwANHKKoYcmsrTVKiT_hjcuqlBfc_gYKvEf-Fk6ggFJbK_cmc82usTrIjkO2J2lN6nd2shKSRN2L5w7NPuLbEOqgXoWnqdIdn94a4D2wI7P-Vr2CxYH_CFFz1AXGVZ4DoNR1DHJKrmu). By carefully controlling their buoyancy, submarines can submerge, surface, and maintain a specific depth [oregonstate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG2q8pgpwj-HzawzV0e_y1anKHcDuYiMB9QzCl7bqV-ctvWo_5Qg7OTUbk4kvg85YObaUWMj6vy249SA-YnsfonXfVsc8a9crGybPXvpCTN2fDc-Lkfw5v51Z-qbN3_Izt_5IfkbgW62In6sBH1SmzY6EfR1BYPaw52Py37eDpJ8IUkwW6laED-SgOLUqrnejCU78cy03H0ws5XDM17ScPEH_dRc2J2BQJg2KcTyQ==).

### Buoyancy Control

The core mechanism for buoyancy control involves **ballast tanks** and **trim tanks** [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHbQgJ0ArM-EJjum_fj2Nqk-1Wn4ewRKSlNKsDLF4TsN-Yws3pEFQGHjDpXmu26mZJOYMraZwZKoFrsZRQe5ALN72SNPAO4VqUY8roVso9B93QPLKhimtQiacW1zTjoqKP-) [nimc](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH4JSvgpDAGFmL3wCWiik_DrcXBuOp6MI29Qi5REKwsM5VVDR4JFU3Ll600Vh7T1aQQRKvQYZu3ba11arl2CLPQiMFLP_t8q62BAAKn50od6E9RzTaQ7dAJJxlEff32KrE8rnv0wTUvHeVdHdxu4PSLZ7VKYzqaoGPJeIgfOD-KFw==). These tanks can be filled with either water or air to adjust the submarine's overall density [oregonstate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG2q8pgpwj-HzawzV0e_y1anKHcDuYiMB9QzCl7bqV-ctvWo_5Qg7OTUbk4kvg85YObaUWMj6vy249SA-YnsfonXfVsc8a9crGybPXvpCTN2fDc-Lkfw5v51Z-qbN3_Izt_5IfkbgW62In6sBH1SmzY6EfR1BYPaw52Py37eDpJ8IUkwW6laED-SgOLUqrnejCU78cy03H0ws5XDM17ScPEH_dRc2J2BQJg2KcTyQ==).

*   **To Dive:** Valves at the top of the ballast tanks are opened, allowing seawater to enter and displace the air [beginnerengineer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEBCoXnZ2J0CZgP4S7nuYGsvw7--nAQ8TZgfc1fFBmXdKwXeRmT-GnzQZ2GhcvdukQi0nhButWz--F9ggA2oIZQ4txTHnWDPLj91YsiNXcHZRGY490vivBGO2J57EQrkeuJ0DPiEqhGaMFTXAO3N7oli1Y5aIVp). As the tanks fill with water, the submarine becomes heavier and denser than the surrounding water, causing it to sink [beginnerengineer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEBCoXnZ2J0CZgP4S7nuYGsvw7--nAQ8TZgfc1fFBmXdKwXeRmT-GnzQZ2GhcvdukQi0nhButWz--F9ggA2oIZQ4txTHnWDPLj91YsiNXcHZRGY490vivBGO2J57EQrkeuJ0DPiEqhGaMFTXAO3N7oli1Y5aIVp) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHbQgJ0ArM-EJjum_fj2Nqk-1Wn4ewRKSlNKsDLF4TsN-Yws3pEFQGHjDpXmu26mZJOYMraZwZKoFrsZRQe5ALN72SNPAO4VqUY8roVso9B93QPLKhimtQiacW1zTjoqKP-).
*   **To Surface:** Compressed air is pumped into the ballast tanks, forcing the water out through the valves [beginnerengineer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEBCoXnZ2J0CZgP4S7nuYGsvw7--nAQ8TZgfc1fFBmXdKwXeRmT-GnzQZ2GhcvdukQi0nhButWz--F9ggA2oIZQ4txTHnWDPLj91YsiNXcHZRGY490vivBGO2J57EQrkeuJ0DPiEqhGaMFTXAO3N7oli1Y5aIVp). This makes the submarine lighter and less dense, allowing buoyancy to push it to the surface [beginnerengineer](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEBCoXnZ2J0CZgP4S7nuYGsvw7--nAQ8TZgfc1fFBmXdKwXeRmT-GnzQZ2GhcvdukQi0nhButWz--F9ggA2oIZQ4txTHnWDPLj91YsiNXcHZRGY490vivBGO2J57EQrkeuJ0DPiEqhGaMFTXAO3N7oli1Y5aIVp) [globecomposite](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHVTgnsKX3tas56PDNgc4Ymsx05x6c3UvW72FphlNwANHKKoYcmsrTVKiT_hjcuqlBfc_gYKvEf-Fk6ggFJbK_cmc82usTrIjkO2J2lN6nd2shKSRN2L5w7NPuLbEOqgXoWnqdIdn94a4D2wI7P-Vr2CxYH_CFFz1AXGVZ4DoNR1DHJKrmu).
*   **To Hover:** Smaller **depth control tanks** (also known as trim tanks) are used for precise depth management. By balancing the amount of water and air in these tanks, a state of neutral buoyancy is achieved, where the submarine's density equals that of the surrounding water [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHbQgJ0ArM-EJjum_fj2Nqk-1Wn4ewRKSlNKsDLF4TsN-Yws3pEFQGHjDpXmu26mZJOYMraZwZKoFrsZRQe5ALN72SNPAO4VqUY8roVso9B93QPLKhimtQiacW1zTjoqKP-) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHFMpzRQh7lZScMk_3TfclzwpRfWoqr0RscBOmWsEFx4As4RcIq-MHad6xF74YwPqJOKEaSFugLuZI3Gk0ZPF3i2iGFdZv_BciYia1Yfg1kZDYNGD_6POxs5KuN6avK82Xkw9du_Q==).

Additionally, **hydroplanes** (movable control surfaces) are used when the submarine is moving to control the rate of ascent or descent and the pitch of the vessel [howstuffworks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGl-wYo9uT0Al4HXYgkTU_-bDz3JwzL2JCu4iVLFglD5wymBqG8ntSpEAvOt9nLZvVDEuB3-m5L1_DKMxpfSo1zyFW8cemIc1kEMgbXmzYFDfxO88VNyVK0M3qabjrVNnDIcNDQ1h6kvS994oy4eO6TX3WKZl6Vsv4PKVjn75QkRJuFTBt7dA==) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF8UTsRS7le1T4TXfxmS9t1Ao_404JFsyl0BRnb4KUSvZfwht5AMaR7hP75_1h_0K3Be7zYo2wjdcBrSQniOfn32nI75S-PP2TqaaT6ZzIIFTrXJeOgh7ONPxZ5opjKbGxR).

### Propulsion

The method of propulsion varies between submarine types:

*   **Diesel-Electric:** Most non-nuclear submarines use diesel engines on the surface to charge large batteries, which then power electric motors for underwater propulsion [explainthatstuff](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE9HuxqvkJKxcDmdc-QbIy7mQgmg21FweBza6VBctSYTiOFq3NeBOduNq5AOP4gID_Q-HbaJHJ4RGeR2XSlw2GADQLkt1JFra1owJyX7MokyFDqmOlUBN_-LSYpc-9w6dCRme3qgnqnBbyz).
*   **Nuclear:** Nuclear submarines utilize nuclear reactors to generate steam that drives turbines for propulsion, enabling extended submerged operations [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHFMpzRQh7lZScMk_3TfclzwpRfWoqr0RscBOmWsEFx4As4RcIq-MHad6xF74YwPqJOKEaSFugLuZI3Gk0ZPF3i2iGFdZv_BciYia1Yfg1kZDYNGD_6POxs5KuN6avK82Xkw9du_Q==) [cognitivemarketresearch](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFQJsDB7w4IS4XhvctLh0_SHSbZWOEU5tsMQ_xwnnSOrYbv1jZ4rF8XZMvyRg7_t5V9etKWNQe-H77SWf3NAZj_MMXicS3V_-FnbrrhN4WsnO86FQIOMrK9qv1Vr0BFo8sspYOUH6SilHjAj35ZP-KQWtstIsFyBUGGCm0Fln2zI1vYsqQkXuBEU6ig).
*   **Air-Independent Propulsion (AIP):** AIP systems allow non-nuclear submarines to operate underwater for longer periods without needing atmospheric oxygen [tkmsgroup](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEPnq422YkapNpi7orgbdRwGNxRoxyFUiAoxrOwo1NO37tfmApKG743noHxxk3Dmvi2OhcqC6_t7nATbLN5hMofJs4pmCyYyU7cwO3SSiu4MWQCSXY=) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQH_H1EEFM0QyMGKI4zQNGiKilTxW65qmgurYQIKRMHf-5ZYblXRdvmgpwG5BX83nonnKylSxrVP01N7Lx_DMy9k8p_oLXCc1sA9ZtyeipfbmLpfDO_Tw0CuAhbYYGvstMPIDJLIBhmuhS4uWv6AIA4NLrY=). These can include technologies like fuel cells and Stirling engines [euro-sd](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG2q8pgpwj-HzawzV0e_y1anKHcDuYiMB9QzCl7bqV-ctvWo_5Qg7OTUbk4kvg85YObaUWMj6vy249SA-YnsfonXfVsc8a9crGybPXvpCTN2fDc-Lkfw5v51Z-qbN3_Izt_5IfkbgW62In6sBH1SmzY6EfR1BYPaw52Py37eDpJ8IUkwW6laED-SgOLUqrnejCU78cy03H0ws5XDM17ScPEH_dRc2J2BQJg2KcTyQ==0).
*   **Lithium-Ion Batteries:** The transition to lithium-ion batteries offers significantly higher usable energy capacity and sustained power delivery for prolonged submerged operations at higher speeds [euro-sd](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFoCcyM7VjSVO4ah8FiBd1m1FVO3BlNSC8NC-jqC3HmmbfUBZgMZpS-01csudllXuLhy97zK2jaynYHN8aFxT5x5QAzGkXJKZaywmq3rp2nQ8m0PQdaNFspXTaURg9h57hKRkpS_tBRmtT0Kitl__gOPAdAe-6izFals5rpIcvmVp9SB8lvYHY9NMQQwV8gzfztPQxnLTxLjuSYraFDly31St_h9YLzL4V0t7LwRjdQm6L8gB2Jqp4IqOZCKUNNdpShGxueZalpvBLIYEIAR2oi5DyftDrkx2FSsYSYAYs=).
*   **Integrated Electrical Propulsion Systems (IEPS):** Some modern submarines use IEPS, which convert engine output to electricity, leading to quieter operation and potential for powering advanced weaponry [spsnavalforces](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHR5XQIxeUlXO7l1oMU5g-UohlEtHV-MxCDFkZ62Hx7kOHCJ6RyqBp6h4Gd88NfpnEQaTaOkZyGUvhTWfNfjc-hHgxQZvEJTvZ6R2GvMpPSDuT8Jw9VzcPlBktxlIW-fs5HPLe8ReyCNtzq9-f8vG9noT7E7Jo9nt91A_9XaPqP44R0JQXpyliQRqFe6ccy7c_1gc9Zyh_GOg==) [spsnavalforces](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEFv_eeagSI3r8iUlajBeEQ8YklLplxLulQiH0-gDelCAVyzrEZ2YIU79JsiUwqx9xtlJaru2miih7ALgu-38_egqC7yI39W4zjxFXQzNgwF-I-rDj6HAMNzxzbo_m5jgqNg33T8w2aQBI4Vvqcri0EnwGH44Q39yZ2xOpPMerzlCAUvtJDW1g188VxwzRYEkQ90ooLgU4sOjsTrw==).
*   **Pump-Jet Propulsion:** This system creates a jet of water, resulting in less cavitation and a lower acoustic signature compared to traditional propellers [globecomposite](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHOt5VD02qp2xGbX1spaf0o8u8F9uTAX0a_xrdTHYO-40dgwSvqutrpaYCQQzh-hVPX7TG451Uevk0X8u86rhN13M069R5crZfpyguRvpFfQCP2e8DYnXagr_wCjxsErPGTP5dz68oLlI4qTJ8b08N-ye83ovrTtYgS) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHHO5VdnmJJJ0tdIcFDPm8Xv9himJQoSV4h4yTA8nIYxe1MOeujG-WXARZNelqk7OGZ8N24luLPC4MH_ZDmtuu-3Sv_FPH5kS9howJryBQ5uIEsw2qxFlT3QMe6Nv698WGGuQ3YQW8yKltpyA==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG-dgqDJdGQTCQwSl-GOKYfrCLykH_7jYe3IUZ3SVAfGRy3LSE1RU0ZVvB7XbKpaY49tGe7x_1k5bIdMB18hE-Ms2TyanaKuNrtb2Vn_jgFqAFte3Ec26qYjFPeYmF9oIKZSNfb16qVuYAPY7b_eyKuZv2Cub2LZP6_0).

This method avoids the instability issues associated with polarization-based entanglement in fiber optics and has been successfully distributed across Vienna's fiber network, indicating its potential for scalable quantum communication systems [quantumzeitgeist](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQE-gGr2se02bXfsvXSSETTaxLg89crotOWY-MQ4gwOOAsdyzBdCNjb_ia_ylkl103EFCygMTCsdvv3Tm7dkwUL82FRR4GHp1uHJYGz-2ZdZbfsUapcj9xgqsblWKi7uJKYzdC58Vik3VZormFubdHqAevH4WYlSQBzmmgfktDAv1B5NaT-pa8Rh). OUTPUT
Stem cells are fundamental to the growth and development of all living organisms, serving as the building blocks for every organ and tissue [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry). They possess two defining characteristics: the ability to self-renew by creating copies of themselves, and the capacity to differentiate into more specialized cell types [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs). While these core abilities are universal, stem cells vary in their potential and the conditions under which they can differentiate [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx).

Stem cells can be broadly categorized by their potency and origin, with the two primary classifications being pluripotent stem cells and tissue-specific (or adult) stem cells [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs).

**Pluripotent Stem Cells:** These cells have the remarkable ability to become any cell type in the body [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk). They are invaluable in research for modeling development and diseases, testing new drugs, and developing cellular therapies [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry).

*   **Embryonic Stem Cells (ESCs):** Found only in the earliest stages of embryonic development, ESCs originate from the inner cell mass of the blastocyst and can give rise to every cell type in the adult body [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk).
*   **Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells (iPSCs):** These are adult cells, such as skin cells, that have been reprogrammed in a laboratory to possess properties similar to ESCs. Like ESCs, iPSCs can differentiate into any cell type in the adult body [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk) [mayoclinic](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHWMjklLbO3_03_Je8Nyu1TV0hV5p_6QTCbWNXCxqVf8Ul49RTmTazFKH0War7hJPE_EyOnkV90cam1-T57oOkNJWUKodrM-gJNq92VDgLdbGWYLmIgs65biyYAuiKBof0YHCEbF4fIpeytdItxZqxLEGFA8Ai-b87DMLZ2-Ot55rfudL366AXgDutK7p_x8dbCGbQ7zOY9QRH7jINW). Significant progress is being made with iPSC therapies, with some entering Phase III clinical trials in 2025 [reprocell](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHpThlFV1vIUJZWb5UHr6_Jpb5F-N3TgWgN8uJpYEyliOAZa6lzrywPdzFB4E9l1eVSyWrbM22TLzjcTAUsrDtG5SHBnPnAIUW5xwrHOMkYBqUTepDQInBdbkaGQ4VxWDu9a5syYt2JceFa5C77Lrzav6-lRm44cSidfEyPWoashq4D9eCp3XCjbUrSfjuybLENxR6L80zqeS3d).

**Tissue-Specific Stem Cells (Adult Stem Cells):** These multipotent stem cells are found in various adult organs and tissues [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs). Their differentiation potential is more limited than pluripotent stem cells, allowing them to develop into a specific range of cell types within their particular lineage or tissue [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk). Their primary role is to replenish cells lost due to normal wear and tear, injury, or disease [aboutstemcells](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHy03Yg0wLYFnM_V3WKsaWhBCb-anqIbPqOtvDvoBgcjpp6R-elIGDh0lSJZrcbw5Rg07LSaNeqXrErJPNHWeg97ysDtexhVYB9uWdVHSeAJ1_CVsxS0WgiDiRENeMPXqWI3VMvToKAwJXl77ry) [nih](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGDKUdCG5ATFPphmYB2I8oA0rQ4uXp-Su1GjuXmU5jwg5XZS3XEeDkNBjYhj1Mk25yJaHT8Rkaw8LM-ut6sKQ88YY5RwWFeSDNzKEByx8fytOcDUNpFpSLKW3k9U8Jv_D__Rm46bESjaaQs). Examples include:

*   **Hematopoietic Stem Cells (HSCs):** Primarily located in the bone marrow, HSCs generate all types of blood cells [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk).
*   **Mesenchymal Stem Cells (MSCs):** Found in tissues like bone marrow, adipose tissue, and umbilical cord, MSCs can differentiate into bone, cartilage, muscle, and fat cells [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_6KBK35kkC5WzR7ycQIgkFgwrLtkgWqjX5JfiTOLoLxk). MSCs and their secreted exosomes are being explored for their potential to harness the body's natural healing abilities [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx).
*   **Neural Stem Cells (NSCs):** These cells produce neurons and supporting cells within the nervous system [omnistem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGlJ2F-4hRXgn6ZNsnsX_WZ79BqcUovy7lRyi0oLGpcsslTgtM7pFIbYxaPgQeQXHLPMdIoqqp4HTHl66xjl2g-hUmUD9Vz4kj_dLlzKpvflwg5PABcsf8B6rKe-rXcuRBQsxAXX_8sp_du5Mx) [dvcstem](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGjTQrLx6pWAmontRuWfJiImQ7qB8lA3iUMoqGuVa4KlaOwbFv-wQVLjlXHYB2KZ4p0H67s5f3JprUGGjSR7szARVa_YXkcqpdC-OzVoK9z9QgfYZ9t6QCREFfJlwD2CEEVOZ0oETJG_

The Global Positioning System (GPS) determines a receiver's location using a method called trilateration. This process relies on calculating the distance between the receiver and multiple satellites, rather than measuring angles as in triangulation [lifewire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHY65a6j2F4mHg2-Y96uK4xipcpbhDQBL9hNiS-48ElMQdtc7vmJmeSEVpH6_nht5KjY-MiUR19NReh_hitwS_xKmW69UYm0aPgEfSOX8Cv6yhb-BV3P8YYDO_yWF_lhe0z8yGvZhwDIjuvXlaqqQil) [gisgeography](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==) [rfwireless-world](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYUCBEWV4GHI9TizDv7g5PbrEH8SLVcQ_yrOaW2xWodCxF4IeQC1ERPmxvdo_VqJa0fAGfbpVrvocedpKddEkbMYqUck4BNs594uXZ6TdcP8bNVX4HTrkRtoRVL94gukGexwxLgCNrFmhirlnyNdrowpBBSv5jrK8rtVEanpm3hoyXti68zQ==) [mapscaping](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfAtSyR_vkm83GzrLjfM6bSFh_9rB1lnIlKzuOV7jxISpF_pa55KOTjEqPaKRD394WtItayw5MnboTyWSHUKf2wWiAYs8N3dTYoe_mtzSaBQzYS7UUKUQNZxga0lIiiSu2-O8FceuCao6h1I08Ir7trg==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGaSiyjmXM_FXacHtTR6inGf9MFeKxl0NqR_VU1T8niA0bvFXOBzOsvHtIRnyU6sN0y-bWvCOOiiy0k4Praqanuk3B_uLrWZOXMBLeeQ9EmjNRW14OWpOyS9ZbF0Bts-S855AMtNqw=).

Here's how it works:

*   **Satellite Signals:** Each GPS satellite continuously broadcasts radio signals that contain its precise orbital position and the exact time the signal was transmitted [innovation](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFD-oSAy5fPwjEyrOKMTVK5FM-yVDfY_x3EdN8YzEZAMBvpzlG-PfjtaPseg-MZDI5aSwvjM4FFuGeSQKXE80zKd_yx90rs5bZI2jIIrwzSNAh3VPah0Pd5e1pGviHOyOz7HF8hW5pgXcZBq5bmVUbW) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=).
*   **Distance Calculation:** A GPS receiver on Earth intercepts these signals. By comparing the transmission time with the reception time and knowing the speed of light, the receiver calculates its distance to each satellite. This is referred to as "pseudo-ranging" due to potential clock synchronization differences [gps](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGEm9bLJRq_eYZN7BEqAzrpeSh8uPUPkEGkEpTjVcRw3YiWENySK3TNQHnry5dPN4b8WeUOVRwyoWSIQqJYMK5FinQNm_Zh6ZtatunLl2Ro5o7WekQXJhJImd_0YA==) [geosolveweb](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEAS2cO7pWb9LdOluXDE_gbWJnSMnQgwE4CHFEu1tqPqVJtRb4B81GIXDUM3tzdRBBg_u5fomrjBrIDYF4KAXWnzDaxataVIKXHAqxW6SEzegO2Km0WJSKwPLh0eHBdzcLzfR4w20cly1x2ZhzqgBDnzoy25tVweztLC2qfF9AUz_O32gtYDjM-) [innovation](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFD-oSAy5fPwjEyrOKMTVK5FM-yVDfY_x3EdN8YzEZAMBvpzlG-PfjtaPseg-MZDI5aSwvjM4FFuGeSQKXE80zKd_yx90rs5bZI2jIIrwzSNAh3VPah0Pd5e1pGviHOyOz7HF8hW5pgXcZBq5bmVUbW) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=).
*   **Trilateration Process:**
    *   With the distance to one satellite, the receiver's possible location is confined to a sphere with the satellite at its center and the calculated distance as the radius [lifewire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHY65a6j2F4mHg2-Y96uK4xipcpbhDQBL9hNiS-48ElMQdtc7vmJmeSEVpH6_nht5KjY-MiUR19NReh_hitwS_xKmW69UYm0aPgEfSOX8Cv6yhb-BV3P8YYDO_yWF_lhe0z8yGvZhwDIjuvXlaqqQil) [gisgeography](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=).
    *   A second satellite's signal introduces a second sphere. The intersection of these two spheres forms a circle, narrowing down the potential locations [lifewire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHY65a6j2F4mHg2-Y96uK4xipcpbhDQBL9hNiS-48ElMQdtc7vmJmeSEVpH6_nht5KjY-MiUR19NReh_hitwS_xKmW69UYm0aPgEfSOX8Cv6yhb-BV3P8YYDO_yWF_lhe0z8yGvZhwDIjuvXlaqqQil) [gisgeography](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=).
    *   A third satellite's signal creates a third sphere. The intersection of this sphere with the circle from the first two satellites yields two possible points. Typically, one point is easily discarded as being unrealistic (e.g., in space or underground), leaving a precise 2D position (latitude and longitude) [lifewire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHY65a6j2F4mHg2-Y96uK4xipcpbhDQBL9hNiS-48ElMQdtc7vmJmeSEVpH6_nht5KjY-MiUR19NReh_hitwS_xKmW69UYm0aPgEfSOX8Cv6yhb-BV3P8YYDO_yWF_lhe0z8yGvZhwDIjuvXlaqqQil) [innovation](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFD-oSAy5fPwjEyrOKMTVK5FM-yVDfY_x3EdN8YzEZAMBvpzlG-PfjtaPseg-MZDI5aSwvjM4FFuGeSQKXE80zKd_yx90rs5bZI2jIIrwzSNAh3VPah0Pd5e1pGviHOyOz7HF8hW5pgXcZBq5bmVUbW) [gisgeography](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==) [eso](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEUCntZbFHaeImfGgFs6ogYUqkqufXQZrsEjDTh1Nbs5PWRoBc17fCnX4v-J9ZiS0Jaemv9V6JLNbr0kuD4UOUK5yKxApRWiVzj1yKBFZHk_lGI4N1eJXVGjkIIWe-d25oCb-A_QCYUgvtpbOvO5f70wBHpS2AeB82UNQDnLgb_zjPv2CV_GQeuWCLOynRY) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=).
*   **The Role of a Fourth Satellite:** While three satellites provide a 2D position, a fourth satellite is essential for determining altitude (a 3D position) and, more critically, for correcting timing inaccuracies in the receiver's clock. The receiver's clock is less precise than the atomic clocks on satellites, and the fourth signal helps synchronize the receiver's clock, resolving for four unknowns: latitude, longitude, altitude, and time [lifewire](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHY65a6j2F4mHg2-Y96uK4xipcpbhDQBL9hNiS-48ElMQdtc7vmJmeSEVpH6_nht5KjY-MiUR19NReh_hitwS_xKmW69UYm0aPgEfSOX8Cv6yhb-BV3P8YYDO_yWF_lhe0z8yGvZhwDIjuvXlaqqQil) [innovation](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFD-oSAy5fPwjEyrOKMTVK5FM-yVDfY_x3EdN8YzEZAMBvpzlG-PfjtaPseg-MZDI5aSwvjM4FFuGeSQKXE80zKd_yx90rs5bZI2jIIrwzSNAh3VPah0Pd5e1pGviHOyOz7HF8hW5pgXcZBq5bmVUbW) [advancednavigation](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==0) [eso](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEUCntZbFHaeImfGgFs6ogYUqkqufXQZrsEjDTh1Nbs5PWRoBc17fCnX4v-J9ZiS0Jaemv9V6JLNbr0kuD4UOUK5yKxApRWiVzj1yKBFZHk_lGI4N1eJXVGjkIIWe-d25oCb-A_QCYUgvtpbOvO5f70wBHpS2AeB82UNQDnLgb_zjPv2CV_GQeuWCLOynRY) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfvdE-CZRlhWkxm2ftyxCOJCCtyZTeRbuR-qx_-i81cpg2CGvZJA1sDsXEX6Vc21G7Vav8QZwQgzZVMBgM_mTVk_4Bm1QlrzU8M4rn9o7_43cNn35OGzOEf1nC2w9dSUWu_CbfSEg=) [mapscaping](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfAtSyR_vkm83GzrLjfM6bSFh_9rB1lnIlKzuOV7jxISpF_pa55KOTjEqPaKRD394WtItayw5MnboTyWSHUKf2wWiAYs8N3dTYoe_mtzSaBQzYS7UUKUQNZxga0lIiiSu2-O8FceuCao6h1I08Ir7trg==) [triglobal](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGV0ymodRV9Gd6vDskArI3I7xdNv1Zm77FC4duUsFcO8MzrUE0SBjK2km9co9Fxt55BoE_3Fl9-9yER_uPEAFqCO0Q4YWyRbeF0l82jey6uhoTdjkUvInwhA2w4t5eodhDNuCrNpkNxZCHtPqRB42LOIzoyMA==1).

**Key Differences from Triangulation:**
Triangulation is a geometric method that uses the measurement of angles from known points to determine a location [rfwireless-world](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEYUCBEWV4GHI9TizDv7g5PbrEH8SLVcQ_yrOaW2xWodCxF4IeQC1ERPmxvdo_VqJa0fAGfbpVrvocedpKddEkbMYqUck4BNs594uXZ6TdcP8bNVX4HTrkRtoRVL94gukGexwxLgCNrFmhirlnyNdrowpBBSv5jrK8rtVEanpm3hoyXti68zQ==) [mapscaping](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFfAtSyR_vkm83GzrLjfM6bSFh_9rB1lnIlKzuOV7jxISpF_pa55KOTjEqPaKRD394WtItayw5MnboTyWSHUKf2wWiAYs8N3dTYoe_mtzSaBQzYS7UUKUQNZxga0lIiiSu2-O8FceuCao6h1I08Ir7trg==) [youtube](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGaSiyjmXM_FXacHtTR6inGf9MFeKxl0NqR_VU1T8niA0bvFXOBzOsvHtIRnyU6sN0y-bWvCOOiiy0k4Praqanuk3B_uLrWZOXMBLeeQ9EmjNRW14OWpOyS9ZbF0Bts-S855AMtNqw=). The ozone layer is a region in Earth's stratosphere that absorbs the majority of the sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) radiation. This absorption is crucial for protecting life on Earth, as excessive UV-B radiation can lead to skin cancer, cataracts, and suppress immune systems in humans. It also negatively impacts marine ecosystems by harming phytoplankton and damages plant life, reducing their carbon storage capacity [nasa](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHm47XJV6VRqP9KC8QvIbWHjcloYjbPF1rB1J3nNRIvafjlof94nuY8F3HEukMHzpldip03HobU-Afs-RqNkYygNDqEqwqzedwtHD1gkNMIKwfzaka26KbBN0f_i70rkm1YKOGTjWWxR4UQg-WQwqrbjtKNazPb7x2Chn8jk01XEYXh663FE6XMP1hAkL9-7GKoJXdXR9z7) [ourworldindata](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHnTrIGgikaMN8e07uMPYhJpI21nfxe6HV4eXKTmWxN6K3Nam6CrJpYYxYwB22ukvbXzRP8QIhWcKJS74ItQwXHDxjjkCMfa_GpnZGZlozZL38Tf_4cZDuKoPUr7BfVgNZQ1e7wMkopDQ==) [researchgate](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGFdYusE-LgzIRMfUHM44dJ6Nj3Fm3Q7sTURx4XHdq1sw1o4i72wmCYHZrMYScRVDCK5hEBGBtmTuyMesxMj-2F3V9ReggiV4f-DJVHV4oUaLDvkmZVbiOcbHt-W8-oJ4y57-x3S8j8m16ucmhmHF_f9BdjeS__oG7dxSUBeIo0DVu7219Fwm4YznfFCfFq4t_mXy-aisMayqFFxVWHn_7h5iReumvVTRA837cBg9Jwid--DvRfKfA=) [earth](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHemdRmzQEgl5noOVMGVk49Fep7AsKimxK6OSTXRaCQ-765PJm5ZWoYSTbokEEytPpLpzdCIEDuM5tOLfEDTymi7ll7wBCrlVlQ2k3HZSr4PxMua68bPQgeRJC3szyzIhEpPHaS-eCJPH93LSvMQTW9w5XaVLUpjN0sSf92XtfDS2X9Dg==) [eia-international](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFavMSorYi_qi2tBnbofyFf3euCAtQG2NUUz58TRDp1FnLIz_xd0EKNu76s42ZHDeWyAaofUsYxQsIqqBzqQlE8nmf9hx_7-wH7_WfUN0qUnDloimmqAfZQPwd-240cmwkO1UHPRhtv7Hr2hZKHOrvNIAGSRU3UBoaQN2UCEGEF4NFU9kbeZ3b3WTsxNgLx17p88UJ9pPx6naLOIBvkuCIqz9x2PTyNl9jnr_wg1EjP4PI=).

Ozone is naturally formed in the stratosphere when solar UV radiation strikes oxygen molecules (O₂), splitting them into individual oxygen atoms. These atoms then combine with other oxygen molecules to create ozone (O₃) [mpg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEzYcCtl6Pl42lOZQaW3XP0pRpPThFV0nyrwp4t2ZFfT9gX8R6VvItITb2ejSPIl7tfeJNko8yca3ZdxS7e81hSGIQeN261KE-AEX4qOoKBzy_k1-97I1MaMLoA-Ys1XTXIFKPQXafh3JnY) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHqXR2GpybzM_PXYQX8GuKwv7D1-B-NWzdOMd4mZcFIwUpkbqDbFAwBS5yDwHnaQSSO5XJQKz5z2vzDDtB90lN23ua9kZAYfdT2OqycyOh0iy6Tpb-Nf7ANFbMRjAkJVFq3WNAEeEHq). The ozone layer is depleted primarily by manufactured chemicals, such as chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) and halons. When these ozone-depleting substances reach the stratosphere, they release halogen atoms that act as catalysts, breaking down ozone molecules into oxygen [mpg](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEzYcCtl6Pl42lOZQaW3XP0pRpPThFV0nyrwp4t2ZFfT9gX8R6VvItITb2ejSPIl7tfeJNko8yca3ZdxS7e81hSGIQeN261KE-AEX4qOoKBzy_k1-97I1MaMLoA-Ys1XTXIFKPQXafh3JnY) [wikipedia](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHqXR2GpybzM_PXYQX8GuKwv7D1-B-NWzdOMd4mZcFIwUpkbqDbFAwBS5yDwHnaQSSO5XJQKz5z2vzDDtB90lN23ua9kZAYfdT2OqycyOh0iy6Tpb-Nf7ANFbMRjAkJVFq3WNAEeEHq). Extremely cold temperatures in polar regions can lead to the formation of polar stratospheric clouds (PSCs), which further exacerbate ozone depletion by providing surfaces for chemical reactions that destroy ozone {

  "kwargs": {
    "question": "How do neural networks learn?",
    "initial_queries": 1,
    "max_loops": 1,
    "reasoning_model": "gemini-2.5-flash-lite"

OUTPUT
Neural networks learn by iteratively adjusting their internal parameters, known as weights and biases, to minimize the difference between their predictions and the actual outcomes [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFYfqVFoFyFcjgOKvvLT10piohKt0wS04QBLSLWW2-ni-4nZ7TVEpUl_uSiVEsSmVCg01zEKdP74oqSbkS_YBjAbo7LVMHkuBLLHiX9KyqWMhHF_yZKcYoiR-7n5hYhGZ55YHTYOLCD7IeaO__tzolfoe6c_rqFq9u3qzNbLz99-ctguvw7z9EMit3WcAjd6Fm3zco5FVSo). This learning process is primarily driven by two key mechanisms: **backpropagation** and **gradient descent** [ibm](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQF_snfHXbd56-ow1THjEItnjjlXGVI4gFxlf5YEBAteHH_0kjR-64LcwTZZkpWnMBgPFCmH703a8pm6QFNsfCqJl63ygxotWq1jNTVsvDJhf6DENGIjpoX2QBqUwsLQLIwYXi13HMNhhGgjAQ==) [ibm](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEk6sZfyKP2EYxML_jmLRqKHVg0hoNqaG_no0BBJRQvFo5_lDwgE3NQbMD6-LYIiDif4OQ5CMpOCeyERp4Mz-HdKhzhN16av6SfNDb_WFjmYFWCeuQY4r7P1TkzE7zzVoeMfijg7ClFFAYKVg==).

**Weights and Biases: The Learnable Parameters**
*   **Weights** are numerical values assigned to the connections between neurons, determining the strength and influence of each input signal [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFYfqVFoFyFcjgOKvvLT10piohKt0wS04QBLSLWW2-ni-4nZ7TVEpUl_uSiVEsSmVCg01zEKdP74oqSbkS_YBjAbo7LVMHkuBLLHiX9KyqWMhHF_yZKcYoiR-7n5hYhGZ55YHTYOLCD7IeaO__tzolfoe6c_rqFq9u3qzNbLz99-ctguvw7z9EMit3WcAjd6Fm3zco5FVSo).
*   **Biases** are additional parameters that provide flexibility by allowing the network to shift the activation function [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFYfqVFoFyFcjgOKvvLT10piohKt0wS04QBLSLWW2-ni-4nZ7TVEpUl_uSiVEsSmVCg01zEKdP74oqSbkS_YBjAbo7LVMHkuBLLHiX9KyqWMhHF_yZKcYoiR-7n5hYhGZ55YHTYOLCD7IeaO__tzolfoe6c_rqFq9u3qzNbLz99-ctguvw7z9EMit3WcAjd6Fm3zco5FVSo).

**The Learning Process**

1.  **Forward Propagation:** Input data is fed through the network. Each input is multiplied by its corresponding weight, and these weighted inputs are summed up. The bias is then added, and the result is passed through an activation function. This process continues layer by layer until an output (a prediction) is generated [datacamp](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEGvbMFdQU-yLDZW9fG9H6xigR93NHbHMscqAIl5Kw_qn3zBKr-_zccxzIB7B78gNhWjE8EstDEMR1vQBc8S7qU93AGP_nEpzs-zBFbM3H7bpi7scynba3NXgzW_rZi9v-4JoOG3Fo7Gp2JLbb-3p8UGVt5yP3u).

2.  **Loss Calculation:** A **loss function** quantifies the error between the network's prediction and the actual target value. The goal of training is to minimize this loss [ibm](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEk6sZfyKP2EYxML_jmLRqKHVg0hoNqaG_no0BBJRQvFo5_lDwgE3NQbMD6-LYIiDif4OQ5CMpOCeyERp4Mz-HdKhzhN16av6SfNDb_WFjmYFWCeuQY4r7P1TkzE7zzVoeMfijg7ClFFAYKVg==).

3.  **Backpropagation:** This is the core algorithm for calculating how much each weight and bias contributes to the overall error. It works by propagating the error backward through the network, using the chain rule of calculus to compute the gradient (the rate of change) of the loss function with respect to each parameter [neuralnetworksanddeeplearning](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQELPCdCrFOrHTVlNMZQbSLMbWCvRTWVN3W3l8cosvtJTHwO4cdAMK2fd0YurxcwaXkyRbB48_8r2wTqXBazNvArOrCxu1SfyRHUxH4IjZsOjuv-TmBc600NoSWILrkjVXo-dQMVY9KVdyrqCCXOMvAweL_t2Ul0VEwZjojYmDkghtKdcykycbRrp_40encVjA==1).

4.  **Gradient Descent:** Once the gradients are calculated via backpropagation, an optimization algorithm, most commonly **gradient descent**, is used to update the weights and biases. Gradient descent iteratively adjusts these parameters in the direction opposite to their gradients to minimize the loss function, controlled by a **learning rate** [neuraldesigner](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQELPCdCrFOrHTVlNMZQbSLMbWCvRTWVN3W3l8cosvtJTHwO4cdAMK2fd0YurxcwaXkyRbB48_8r2wTqXBazNvArOrCxu1SfyRHUxH4IjZsOjuv-TmBc600NoSWILrkjVXo-dQMVY9KVdyrqCCXOMvAweL_t2Ul0VEwZjojYmDkghtKdcykycbRrp_40encVjA==4). Various optimization algorithms like Adam, RMSprop, and AdaGrad are also used [neuraldesigner](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQELPCdCrFOrHTVlNMZQbSLMbWCvRTWVN3W3l8cosvtJTHwO4cdAMK2fd0YurxcwaXkyRbB48_8r2wTqXBazNvArOrCxu1SfyRHUxH4IjZsOjuv-TmBc600NoSWILrkjVXo-dQMVY9KVdyrqCCXOMvAweL_t2Ul0VEwZjojYmDkghtKdcykycbRrp_40encVjA==4).

This iterative cycle enables neural networks to learn complex patterns from data and make increasingly accurate predictions [geeksforgeeks](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQFYfqVFoFyFcjgOKvvLT10piohKt0wS04QBLSLWW2-ni-4nZ7TVEpUl_uSiVEsSmVCg01zEKdP74oqSbkS_YBjAbo7LVMHkuBLLHiX9KyqWMhHF_yZKcYoiR-7n5hYhGZ55YHTYOLCD7IeaO__tzolfoe6c_rqFq9u3qzNbLz99-ctguvw7z9EMit3WcAjd6Fm3zco5FVSo).

Recent research has also identified the **Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP)** as a mathematical mechanism that characterizes feature learning in neural networks [broadinstitute](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHw6bI-t_ey8trkx0xMxwCUZEyInOrfaCMyJ00bSHf-brmVtrr6b7dbiIRWBwbV0N0Qf0baQcyipLVc_fDiT3ihrhMIVnr_8jpnB6cNOzkEA3X4XSwM8SsUkiYKp85RpdecI-jlmOJnDGDq4KM8uESd7KaK). AGOP quantifies the sensitivity of model outputs to changes in input directions and can potentially enable feature learning without relying on backpropagation [broadinstitute](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQHw6bI-t_ey8trkx0xMxwCUZEyInOrfaCMyJ00bSHf-brmVtrr6b7dbiIRWBwbV0N0Qf0baQcyipLVc_fDiT3ihrhMIVnr_8jpnB6cNOzkEA3X4XSwM8SsUkiYKp85RpdecI-jlmOJnDGDq4KM8uESd7KaK). This understanding contributes to developing simpler, more efficient, and interpretable machine learning models [sciencedaily](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEXGxGwWGgox4O79hA8wzTltPlmvqsjaogRbZoi9zm-iN4SroW6qHgXl_H6AYqF6jNx78mTg7Ydyg1MqQ2AIv8jETzOX6gEmuAiKSFRf0QbeKMv-qlvFvJlFu2l5kywlDw8nzQv2jF_fqMEyJR_2ZedMMIAqEkxiBM2).

Furthermore, techniques like **"guidance"** are being explored to improve the performance of challenging neural network architectures by aligning them with the internal representations of a guide network, effectively transferring structural knowledge [mit](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQGxtM8JaitGEFd_mKJBrjAyc8Nd4lbdyYofWw68pOGCjo7LH358-VramjvgGpyUssZMuGdT7g9IGyc8GAEnw6aQsjU6rVOaNanUnwGXvlCodovfSMTcKhPuPkRuTCQuaY65kL88abUvanVHTeLd8xyoOgislGkbCZQK0ryDIB-GaXg10Hu-00NyBADOfCFedtzhG8iOM_7OO84rYX4lpMbFcjo=). Additionally, **Nested Learning** offers a paradigm shift by viewing models as a collection of nested optimization problems with differential update frequencies to mitigate catastrophic forgetting and enable continuous learning [research](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQEhaIpBnwE0l_iH5SzyeO1L5dpeSh2f8HTp8R4bceeTW5gstd6ijLp9XBNdYp-s5hzrIZC1IK_nx2yNEo9Q045gz45JD5pcJ3vYAV2lkZ9X61t4LnKi6DNWTzpRttbXjRmD4HiI42B4BW92TqbFuE3IeaO8pfuivqMeGoAorkaW4QXEz8vhedlBOS9CagTZLp1Lit8VHdFMRbt73nzE). The integration of **Neuro-Symbolic AI** combines the pattern recognition of neural networks with symbolic reasoning to create more robust and interpretable AI systems [anshadameenza](https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/grounding-api-redirect/AUZIYQG_JYPPNww3a-FIDqctdb9fF_xhWNZ2SsTLCI-LcSO18ZPGV0toiESAG80Sbbgts_Dm7xOuaRcfZtzPjSK9M9sC0NZuDgdYngQFb1_0JaEeT4GGrRJ6z3b1O791or2LNLeC5U22C8gu7LRTv5IyRa8GNNdK7wNXlg56Cex5).

    "question": "Explain how the immune system works.",
    "initial_queries": 1,
    "max_loops": 1,
